source.title: Wikipedia: Argand lamp
source.gives: Invented 1780 by Aime Argand; hollow wick, glass chimney; whale, seal, colza or olive oil by gravity feed; 6 to 10 candelas, Jefferson 'six or eight candles'; reached Jefferson 1784; Quinquet in France
